notes.title: Big Content Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458184/8f496e513c48f0f947781a510918d9203b82a91f.png

There is more to discover in the depths of the ancient ocean! Put your skills to the test and battle a new secret boss! Search the caverns and uncover ancient ruins! Swim alone no longer--complete your adventure with a clam and sea urchin pet!

Added Features:

New Secret Boss
Clam Buddy
New Platforming Challenge
Sea Urchin Buddy
Quality of life updates
